header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: met him and remarked, "You are a most beloved servant of Allaah." Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) said, "Then get me married (to one of your daughters)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) remained silent. Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) further said, "You consider me a beloved servant of Allaah but are not happy to have me as your son-in-law?"

The next morning, some of Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s family members approached Hadhrat Salmaan (RA). "Do you people need something?" he asked. When they admitted that they did, he said, "What is it? It shall gladly be fulfilled." They said, "We request that you abandon the matter i.e. your proposal to Hadhrat Umar (RA)." "By Allaah!" Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) emphasised, "You should remember well that I did not make the proposal because of his being the Khalifah and ruler. The truth is that I thought to myself that because he is a pious man, perhaps Allaah will produce pious offspring from his progeny and mine." Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) then got married to a woman from the Kindah tribe. The rest of the narration is like the one above. [^1]
The Marriage of Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA)

Hadhrat Thaabit Bunaani reports that Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) once went with Hadhrat Salmaan Faarsi (RA) to extend a proposal on his behalf for a woman of the Banu Layth tribe. Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) went in to see the family and told them in detail that Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) was one of the early Muslims and also recounted his acceptance of Islaam. He then proceeded to mention to them that Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) wished to marry a particular girl of their family. Their reply was, "While we do not wish to get Salmaan (RA) married (to our daughter), we wouldn't mind getting you married (to her)." They then handed her over in marriage to him and he left.

(When he met Hadhrat Salmaan (RA)) Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) said, "Something has happened that I am too embarrassed to tell you about." "What is it?" Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) asked. When Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) related the incident to him, Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) said, "I should be the one embarrassed since I proposed for a woman whom Allaah had destined for you." [^2]
Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) gets his Daughter Dardaa Married to One of the Poor and Simple Muslims

Hadhrat Thaabit Bunaani narrates that when Yazeed bin Mu'aawiya sent to Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) a proposal for his daughter Dardaa, he rejected the proposal.
